claims.text: The Assembly reports that Interim Speaker Lord Tangi issued invitations to all Elected Representatives to nominate a candidate for Prime Minister Designate, following the return of the writ of election from the Electoral Commission to the King on Tuesday 30 November 2021. It states that nominations close at 4.30pm on Tuesday 14 December 2021.
claims.uncertainty: The invitations are dated only by the notice's 'today' and its 1 December creation date. A procedural notice: it names no candidate and records no result.
